title: Helpdesk Support Specialist
description:
We are seeking an analytical Helpdesk Support Specialist with 6 months to 1 year of experience to manage our support queue and bridge the gap between our clients and internal teams. In this role, you will monitor incoming tickets, clarify issue details directly with customers, and coordinate seamlessly with L1, L2, L3 support, Process Consultants, and Developers to drive ticket resolutions without getting bogged down in code level debugging.

**Key Responsibilities**

• Queue Monitoring & Management: Monitor and track incoming support tickets via Zoho Desk (or equivalent ticketing platforms), prioritizing and responding to requests across email and IVR channels.

• Customer Clarification: Engage directly with users to gather context, reproduce issues, and clarify ambiguities regarding the business challenge behind each ticket.

• Process-Level Triage: Analyze support queries against overall business workflows rather than code architecture, assessing whether issues stem from user error, configuration needs, or system gaps.

• Cross-Functional Coordination: Act as the primary operational link between customers, internal Process Consultants, and Developers to ensure smooth ticket routing and escalation through L1, L2, and L3 tiers.

• Translation & Liaison: Translate non-technical customer pain points into clear, actionable functional requirements for developers and consultants.

• Lifecycle Tracking: Own the end-to-end journey of support tickets from initial intake and triage to testing, user verification, and final closure.

**Key Qualifications & Skills**

• Experience: 6 months to 1 year of experience in a helpdesk support, technical service

desk, or customer-facing operational role. (Zoho Desk experience is a plus, but not

mandatory).

• Business Acumen: Solid grasp of standard business processes and operational

workflows, focusing on how applications serve end-user needs.

• Communication Skills: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills to

articulate client requirements clearly across technical and non-technical teams.

• Problem-Solving & Inquiry: Strong analytical mindset to ask the right clarifying

questions, test functional workarounds, and investigate root operational causes.

• Time Management: Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple concurrent

support tickets calmly and efficiently in a fast-paced environment.

**Work Schedule & What We Offer**

• Work Schedule: 6 working days per week (Monday through Friday on-site/hybrid as

per location policy; Saturday dedicated as Work-From-Home).

• Competitive compensation with structured performance-based career growth.

• Comprehensive onboarding, mentorship, and exposure to enterprise business

automation tools.

• A supportive, collaborative culture that values continuous learning.

title: Oracle HCM Functional Consultant
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled Oracle Cloud Payroll Consultant with extensive experience in payroll costing and its integration with General Ledger. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of Oracle Cloud Payroll modules, strong analytical skills, and a proven ability to deliver successful implementations and support in a consulting environment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Implementation and Support: Lead and manage Oracle Cloud Payroll implementation projects, including requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, testing, and deployment.
* Costing Expertise: Provide expert guidance on payroll costing, including setup, configuration, and troubleshooting of costing rules and processes.
* Client Collaboration: Work closely with clients to understand their payroll processes and requirements, offering recommendations for improvements and optimizations.
* Documentation: Develop and maintain project documentation, including functional specifications, test plans, and user guides.
* Training and Support: Conduct training sessions for clients and provide ongoing support to ensure successful adoption of Oracle Cloud Payroll solutions.
* Issue Resolution: Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to Oracle Cloud Payroll, providing timely and effective support to clients.
* Best Practices: Stay updated with the latest Oracle Cloud Payroll features, functionalities, and industry best practices to provide innovative solutions to clients.

**Qualifications**

* Experience: Minimum of 3 years of experience in Oracle Cloud Payroll implementation and support, with a focus on payroll costing.
* Technical Skills: Proficiency in Oracle Cloud Payroll modules, including Core HR, Benefits, and Compensation. Strong understanding of payroll costing rules and processes.
* Analytical Skills: Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to interpret complex payroll requirements and deliver effective solutions.
* 4+ years of experience in Cloud Payroll
* 3+ years of experience in Payroll Costing and US Taxation
* Accounting background is an added advantage

**Minimum One End-to-end Implementation Experience Required**
Experience in US Payroll is preferredSkills: oracle,payroll,cloud

title: Technical Support Representative
description:
**Company Description**
Mexaware Solutions is a specialist IT solutions company based in Thrissur, Kerala, India, operating at the intersection of innovation and practicality. The team focuses on RFID and Bluetooth (BLE) tracking systems, barcode solutions, web development, mobile applications, and cloud infrastructure with DevOps. Mexaware delivers end-to-end technology solutions for asset management, people monitoring, inventory, point-of-sale, and broader digital transformation. Using a modern tech stack including Node.js, React.js, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MSSQL, Android, AWS, Kafka, MQTT, and Fastify, the company emphasizes simplicity, scalability, and timely delivery. Trusted by industry leaders such as Centena Group and ScreenCheck, Mexaware maintains a client-first mindset and a commitment to excellence.
  
**Role Description**
The Technical Support Representative is a full-time, on-site role based in Thrissur, Kerala. This role involves providing timely and accurate technical assistance to customers, including diagnosing issues, troubleshooting hardware and software problems, and guiding users through solutions. The representative will manage support tickets, document incidents, escalate complex issues to engineering teams, and follow up to ensure resolution and customer satisfaction. Daily tasks include responding to queries via phone, email, or chat, maintaining knowledge base articles, and collaborating with internal teams to improve products and services. The role also requires monitoring recurring issues, suggesting process improvements, and contributing to a high-quality support experience.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong Customer Support and Customer Satisfaction skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and professionally.
* Hands-on Technical Support and Troubleshooting skills for software, hardware, and network-related issues.
* Solid Analytical Skills to diagnose problems, identify root causes, and propose effective solutions.
* Comfort working with IT concepts and tools; familiarity with web, mobile, or RFID/BLE systems is an advantage.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; additional local language skills are a plus.
* Ability to work on-site in Thrissur, manage multiple cases simultaneously, and maintain accurate documentation.
* Prior experience in technical or customer support roles is preferred; exposure to SaaS or IT services is beneficial.
* Relevant diploma or degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field is desirable.

title: Customer Relations Executive
description:
Role Overview
   

  

 Connect with customers, handle inquiries, resolve issues efficiently, and ensure a smooth experience while maintaining strong communication and customer satisfaction throughout interactions. We are seeking a dynamic Customer Relationship Executive to join our Customer Relations team in Thrissur. The role involves managing client portfolios for our WhatsApp Chatbot service, understanding customer needs, and ensuring seamless adoption of our software solutions. The ideal candidate will combine interpersonal excellence with technical awareness to drive satisfaction and long\-term success.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Develop and maintain strong client relationships through regular communication (calls, emails, meetings).
* Understand customer requirements and provide tailored solutions aligned with business goals.
* Deliver exceptional customer support, including troubleshooting and timely issue resolution.
* Collaborate with sales, marketing, and product teams to address client needs and identify new opportunities.
* Create and execute customer success plans to enhance satisfaction and retention.
* Conduct periodic business reviews to track client outcomes and optimize solution usage.
* Provide feedback to internal teams to guide product development and marketing strategies.


**Requirements**
* Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or certifications in Python/AI.
* Minimum 1 year of professional experience in customer\-facing or technical support roles.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with fluency in English.
* Knowledge of software development methodologies and technologies.
* Female candidates below 35 years preferred.

title: Service Now Senior Technical Consultant
description:
******Company Overview******
 Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee\-first, performance\-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category\-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. The company specializes in providing solutions across Application Services and Consulting, Digital Product Engineering, Digital Workplace Services, Private Cloud Services, AI/Automation, and ServiceNow. Milestone culture is built to provide a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports employees and empowers them to reach their full potential.
   

  

 Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short\-term and long\-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people\-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry\-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.
   

  

******Job Overview******
 Milestone Technologies is actively seeking a Senior ServiceNow Technical Consultant to join their team on a full\-time basis. The company is looking for experienced ServiceNow delivery experts with a strong background in assisting organizations in adopting service management and asset management best practices and optimizing them on the ServiceNow platform. The successful candidate will possess expertise in service management/asset management process design and ServiceNow configuration and development.
   

  

******Responsibilities******
* Collaborate with clients to assess current state processes and tools, identify ServiceNow platform solution options, define requirements, determine integration needs, and develop comprehensive architecture and implementation plans for broad\-scope and complex projects
* Work with Milestone Technologies business development and leadership teams to scope new project opportunities and contribute to proposal development
* Lead and conduct requirements, scoping, and design workshops, ensuring thorough documentation of requirements
* Provide expert\-level support and technical mentoring to the Milestone Technologies implementation team
* Maintain a deep and comprehensive knowledge of ServiceNow's capabilities and constraints
* Stay informed about industry trends, competitors, third\-party solutions, and integrations.
* Collaborate with technical consultants, customers, and project teams to architect and design solutions that leverage native configuration opportunities
* Identify and develop opportunities to leverage ServiceNow as a platform for custom applications both within and outside of ITSM
* Deliver hands\-on configuration, development, and integration services as a senior technical member of the team, ensuring delivery assurance for all project deliverables
* Plan and coordinate all phases of testing and test acceptance, leading test remediation cycles
* Lead practice build efforts, including the development of practice intellectual property (IP)


**Skills**
* Expert\-level understanding and implementation experience with at least two of the following three ServiceNow application suites: ITOM, ITSM, ITAM, HRSD, CSM, GRC/IRM, and/or SecOps
* Expert\-level understanding of ServiceNow core application UI and workflow configuration, report development, and integration components (e.g., LDAP, SSO)
* Experience leading at least three full lifecycle ServiceNow implementations.
* Minimum of 5 years experience with ServiceNow
* Advanced experience with web technologies (XML, HTML, JavaScript, Web Services, etc.)
* Excellent understanding of implementation methodologies/SDLC (e.g., Agile Scrum, Waterfall)
* Minimum of 3\+ years experience soliciting and documenting requirements and evolving these requirements into successful solutions
* Excellent interpersonal skills with experience establishing and maintaining credibility as a ServiceNow expert
* Experience and comfort in public speaking situations (IP)


******Skills******
* 8\+ years within the ITSM industry, including asset management
* 5\+ years of experience with the ServiceNow Platform
* 5\+ years of professional services/consulting experience
* Advanced level understanding of ServiceNow application UI and workflow configuration, report development, and integration components (e.g., LDAP, SSO, etc.)
* Experience in reconciling software license positions
* Integration experience, including but not limited to SCCM or other software discovery tools
* Participation in at least two full lifecycle ServiceNow implementations
* Excellent understanding of implementation methodologies/SDLC (e.g., Agile Scrum, Waterfall)
* ServiceNow Certifications for System Administrator and Certified Implementation Specialist (or commitment to attain these certifications within 90 days of hire date)
